user.title: Connect your decision model
user.description: Create a decision sensor using a local or remote model endpoint. If you have existing decision sensors, the most recently configured connection is prefilled, including its masked API key. Change or clear those fields to use a different connection. Configure the question and input entities in the next steps.

data_description.api_url: Typed JSON: enter the complete /v1/systemone URL. Chat completions: enter the complete /v1/chat/completions URL. No path is appended.
data_description.model: Use the model identifier accepted by your endpoint. For Laya typed-decisions, use typed-decisions.

question_type.title: Build your question
question_type.description: Choose a guided question type or edit the full question map. Guided editing replaces the question map with one question; use advanced editing to preserve multiple questions.

menu_options.noul: Noul — probability a statement is true

choice.title: Choice question
choice.description: Write the decision question. Enter 2–255 options, one per line: label: description. Labels become the sensor state, for example charge: Battery needs charging. A line without a colon uses the same text as label and description.

data.criteria: Choice options (one label: description per line)

noul.title: Noul question
noul.description: Write a statement to evaluate, such as “The battery needs charging.” Add descriptions for true and false. The sensor reports probability true from 0 to 1; 0.8 means 80%. Noul is a probability, so use numeric thresholds in automations.

score.title: Score question
score.description: Write what should be rated. Enter 2–10 distinct level descriptions, one per line, in order from lowest to highest. Levels are numbered from 0; three levels produce an expected score from 0 to 2.

advanced.title: Advanced questions
advanced.description: Enter a named question map as JSON. All model-specific types and fields are preserved. Set a primary question to expose one answer as the sensor state.

data_description.primary_question: For multiple questions, use this question as the sensor state. Leave blank for a completed state with all answers in attributes.

behavior.title: Choose inputs and refresh behavior
behavior.description: Select the Home Assistant entities your question needs. The sensor evaluates after startup and input changes when automatic evaluation is enabled.

data.auto_update: Evaluate at startup and when inputs change

data_description.references: Only these entities and their attributes are sent to your model. Select the inputs needed to answer the question.
data_description.auto_update: Disable for manual-only evaluation via the Refresh decision action. This also disables periodic refresh.

error.invalid_name: Enter a nonempty name or identifier.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS endpoint with a valid host and port. Embedded credentials and URL fragments are not supported.
error.invalid_json: Enter a nonempty JSON object of named questions, each with a type.
error.invalid_question: The primary question must match an identifier in your question map.
error.invalid_instructions: Enter a question and nonempty descriptions.
error.invalid_choices: Enter 2–255 unique labels, each with a nonempty description.

abort.already_configured: A decision with this name already exists.
